heading: Partnerships with historically Black colleges and universities, Hispanic-serving institutions, and tribal colleges

children.heading: Hispanic-serving institution
children.text: The term “Hispanic-serving institution” has the meaning given the term in section 1101a(a) of title 20.

children.heading: Historically Black college or university
children.text: The term “historically Black college or university” has the meaning given the term “part B institution” in section 1061 of title 20.

children.heading: National Laboratory
children.text: The term “National Laboratory” has the meaning given the term in section 15801 of this title.

children.heading: Science facility
children.text: The term “science facility” has the meaning given the term “single-purpose research facility” in section 16182 of this title.

children.heading: Tribal college
children.text: The term “tribal college” has the meaning given the term “tribally controlled college or university” in section 1801(a) of title 25.

tree.heading: Education partnership
tree.text: The Secretary shall require the director of each National Laboratory, and may require the head of any science facility, to increase the participation of historically Black colleges or universities, Hispanic-serving institutions, or tribal colleges in any activity that increases the capacity of the historically Black colleges or universities, Hispanic-serving institutions, or tribal colleges to train personnel in science or engineering.

tree.heading: Activities
tree.text: An activity described in subsection (b) includes—

children.text: training activities carried out at a National Laboratory or science facility; and
mentoring activities carried out at a National Laboratory or science facility.

tree.heading: Report
tree.text: Not later than 2 years after August 8, 2005, the Secretary shall submit to Congress a report describing the activities carried out under this section.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: A prior section 3167 of Pub. L. 101–510 was renumbered section 3168 and is classified to section 7381d of this title.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2008—Subsec. (a)(5). Pub. L. 110–315 made technical amendment to reference in original act which appears in text as reference to section 1801(a) of title 25.
